decisions.ask: The loans file under app/lending was modified while this task ran and is not mine. What happens to it?

recommended.door: You commit or set aside your change to the loans file yourself, then reply and I commit only the two new fee files.
recommended.why: The commit stops on a folder holding a change this task did not make, and never widens to take it.
recommended.reverses_if: you tell me the loans change belongs to this task.

others.what_it_does: Excluded: committing the loans change with the new files would put a change I did not write into this task's commit, which the rules forbid.

decisions.if_none: Nothing is committed; the new fee files stay uncommitted beside your loans change.
